rationale: The Latin anchor "odoratus est Dominus odorem suavitatis" (Genesis 8:21: "the Lord smelled a sweet/pleasant odor") strongly indicates a pleasant scent, aligning with aroma.n.02 ("a distinctive odor that is pleasant") rather than the neutral tracking sense of scent.n.02 or the abstract property sense of olfactory_property.n.01. The glossary citation (Ælfc. Gl.) further confirms a lexical sense tied to agreeable smell (odoramen).
